title: Text Classification reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong solution for Text Classification should meet the objective: Design a basic text-classification workflow and review representative false positives and false negatives, including a note on tokenization or data quality. It should preserve a repeatable test setup, document its assumptions, and distinguish measured results from hypotheses.
explanation: Review the reasoning, not only the required words: inspect whether the test design matches the objective, the result is reproducible, and limitations are reported honestly.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
